mod.overview: Mortar Men v1.1 (IntauraMODs / Michael Wales, July 1999) removes Light Armor, Medium Armor, and Laser Rifle so every player spawns in a lightened, faster Heavy Armor that can pilot vehicles, fires discs/grenades/mortars faster, and carries expanded explosive reserves.
notes: Heavy-only class (ArmorData.cs, game.cs, vehicle.cs): Game::playerSpawn spawns all players in harmor (Vehicle::onCollision lets harmor board Scouts/APCs). Heavy Armor drops mass from 18 to 16, moves faster (5/4/4 -> 7/6/6), and cuts jet drain (1.1 -> 0.8).

Expanded ordnance & faster reloads: Heavy carry caps increase for Discs (15 -> 35), Mortar Ammo (10 -> 30), Grenade Ammo (15 -> 20), and Mines (3 -> 5). Mortar and Grenade Launcher reloadTime speeds up 0.5 s -> 0.3 s, and Disc Launcher reloads 0.25 s -> 0.2 s.
Sensors trimmed (sensor.cs): lowers PulseSensor (400 -> 350 m), MediumPulseSensor (250 -> 200 m), and DeployablePulseSensor (200 -> 150 m) ranges, and tweaks station collision/resupply scripts.

GrenadeLauncher.summary: Reload delay drops from 0.5 s to 0.3 s while Heavy Grenade Ammo capacity rises from 15 to 20.

Mortar.summary: Reload delay drops from 0.5 s to 0.3 s and Heavy Mortar shell cap triples from 10 to 30.

DiscLauncher.summary: Reload delay drops from 0.25 s to 0.2 s and Heavy Disc capacity increases from 15 to 35.
notes: Supports extended Heavy disc fighting and mobility.

DeployableAmmoPack.summary: Removes the station WeaponCheck gate and updates onActivate resupply handling for Heavy-only play.
notes: Pairs with expanded explosive ammo pools.
